e.title: 一个「嵌入式宠物险」客户端 SDK：仓库里**只有桥接层**——承保与保单逻辑全在托管的远端流程里，连集成文档也不在仓库内；而同一产品还有 Android 与 Flutter 三个平台封装
e.title_en: A client SDK for embedded pet insurance whose repository holds only the bridge layer, with underwriting and policy logic living in a hosted remote flow and even the integration guide kept off-repo, while the same product ships three platform wrappers
e.title_hk: 一個「嵌入式寵物險」客戶端 SDK：倉庫裡**只有橋接層**——承保與保單邏輯全在託管的遠端流程裡，連集成文檔也不在倉庫內；而同一產品還有 Android 與 Flutter 三個平台封裝
e.summary: 一份**内嵌式宠物险**的 iOS 客户端 SDK（Swift Package）：**把托管的保险流程嵌进 `WKWebView`**，并实现一套原生桥接（`GuavasureBridge`）以支持**原生 Razorpay 结账、文件选择、相机拍摄与合作伙伴鉴权**；**其最值得记的一处是「你拿到的到底是什么」这个边界被文件清单本身说清了**——**实测其源码目录只有十几个文件，全部属于「配置 ＋ 呈现 ＋ 桥接 ＋ 支付 ＋ 安全策略」五类**（`GuavaSureEmbedConfig`、`GuavaSureEmbedViewController`、`GuavaSureUrlBuilder`、三文件组成的 `Bridge/`、`Internal/` 下两个传输辅助、`Payment/PaymentLauncher`、`Security/Policies`），**而没有任何承保、定价、产品或保单逻辑**；**且逐字声明所嵌的是**「the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow」**（**托管的流程**）**，**其**完整的集成指南也不在仓库里**（**指向 `partners.guavasure.com` 上的页面**）**；**另有三处可核实事实**：**① 桥接协议在**三个平台**上共用**（**逐字「Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）」**，**故本词条**只收其一**，**因 iOS 与 Android 两个仓库是**同一产品按平台拆分**的近重复**）；**② 它用 **GPL-3.0** 许可发布一个**供合作方嵌入**的客户端 SDK****（**⚠️ 本词条只如实记录这一许可选择及其**可能的**含义，**不作法律结论**）；**③ 其中一条特性写的是一个**具体的工程取舍****：**「No embed reload on Safari return（**embed polls in background**）」**
e.summary_hk: 一份**內嵌式寵物險**的 iOS 客戶端 SDK（Swift Package）：**把託管的保險流程嵌進 `WKWebView`**，並實現一套原生橋接（`GuavasureBridge`）以支持**原生 Razorpay 結賬、文件選擇、相機拍攝與合作夥伴鑑權**；**其最值得記的一處是「你拿到的到底是什麼」這個邊界被文件清單本身說清了**——**實測其源碼目錄只有十幾個文件，全部屬於「配置 ＋ 呈現 ＋ 橋接 ＋ 支付 ＋ 安全策略」五類**（`GuavaSureEmbedConfig`、`GuavaSureEmbedViewController`、`GuavaSureUrlBuilder`、三文件組成的 `Bridge/`、`Internal/` 下兩個傳輸輔助、`Payment/PaymentLauncher`、`Security/Policies`），**而沒有任何承保、定價、產品或保單邏輯**；**且逐字聲明所嵌的是**「the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow」**（**託管的流程**）**，**其**完整的集成指南也不在倉庫裡**（**指向 `partners.guavasure.com` 上的頁面**）**；**另有三處可核實事實**：**① 橋接協議在**三個平台**上共用**（**逐字「Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）」**，**故本詞條**只收其一**，**因 iOS 與 Android 兩個倉庫是**同一產品按平台拆分**的近重複**）；**② 它用 **GPL-3.0** 許可發布一個**供合作方嵌入**的客戶端 SDK****（**⚠️ 本詞條只如實記錄這一許可選擇及其**可能的**含義，**不作法律結論**）；**③ 其中一條特性寫的是一個**具體的工程取捨****：**「No embed reload on Safari return（**embed polls in background**）」**
e.summary_en: An iOS client SDK for embedded pet insurance, distributed as a Swift package, that embeds a hosted insurance flow in a web view and implements a native bridge supporting native Razorpay checkout, file picking, camera capture and partner authentication; **its most notable feature is that what you actually receive is bounded by the file listing itself** — **its source directory measurably holds only about a dozen files, all falling into five categories, configuration, presentation, bridging, payment and security policy, with no underwriting, pricing, product or policy logic anywhere in the repository**; **and it states verbatim that what it embeds is the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow, with the full integration guide kept off-repo at a partner site**; **three further checkable facts**: **the bridge protocol is shared across three platforms** — verbatim, the same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and a Flutter package published elsewhere — **which is why only one of them is collected here, the iOS and Android repositories being near-duplicate siblings of a single product split by platform**; **it releases, under GPL-3.0, a client SDK intended for partners to embed**, a licensing choice recorded here factually with its possible implications and without any legal conclusion; **and one of its listed features records a specific engineering trade-off, that the embed does not reload on returning from Safari because it polls in the background**
e.body:
**embedded-pet-insurance-sdk**（仓库 `guavasure/guavasure-ios`）**是一份内嵌式宠物险的 iOS 客户端 SDK**（**Swift Package**）：**把托管的保险流程嵌进 `WKWebView`，并实现一套原生桥接**。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **GPL-3.0**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主语言 Swift、仓库体量 45 KB、创建 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-08、无 topics、无 homepage 字段**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 2,767 字节**；**仓库实测共 21 个条目（15 个文件、6 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「按部分声明：许可、能力、交付物与使用者各自适用什么规则」**；**⭐ 它是四条里**把「交付物按部分分」表现得最明显的一条——**不是靠文档说明，而是**文件清单本身**就说明了****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「你拿到的是什么」由文件清单本身界定：仓库里只有桥接与呈现层**——**这是本条最值得记的一处**：**其 README 第一句逐字为** **「Swift Package that **embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in `WKWebView`** and implements `GuavasureBridge` for **native Razorpay Checkout, file pick, camera capture, and partner auth**.」**；**而 **本词条实测其源码清单逐项为**：**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/GuavaSureEmbedConfig.swift`**（**配置**）、**`GuavaSureEmbedViewController.swift`**（**承载嵌入流程的视图控制器**）、**`GuavaSureUrlBuilder.swift`**（**URL 构造**）、**`GuavaSureEmbedWarmup.swift`**（**预热**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Bridge/{BridgeDispatcher, BridgeInjection, BridgeScriptMessageHandler}.swift`**（**桥接三件**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Internal/{ChunkedJsDelivery, JsStringEncoding}.swift`**（**两个传输／编码辅助**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Payment/PaymentLauncher.swift`**（**支付启动**）、**`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/Security/Policies.swift`**（**安全策略**），**另有根目录 `Package.swift`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`.gitignore`**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **文件清单里**没有任何承保、定价、产品、保单或理赔逻辑****——**⭐ 即**这个 SDK 的全部工作是**把远端流程装进一个视图并把消息来回转**；**本词条认为这是本轮主题在**仓库层面**的体现：**「你拿到的是什么」不需要读文档，**看文件清单就知道****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它逐字用**「hosted」**这个词**（**the **hosted** GuavaSure insurance flow**）**——**⭐ 即**真正的产品在别处运行****；**③ ⭐⭐ **它有一个**独立的 `Security/` 目录与 `Policies.swift`****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该文件**，**故**不转述**其内容，**也不猜想**它管什么**）**——**⭐ 但本词条指出：**在一个只有桥接层的 SDK 里**单独给出安全策略文件**，**至少说明**嵌入第三方流程这件事**被认为有安全面**；**④ **`Internal/` 下两个辅助中有一个是**分块投递 JS****，**⭐ 即**注入脚本可能较大、需要分块**（**⚠️ 这是本词条据文件名的**推断**，**已标明为推断**）**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **集成文档不在仓库里**——**逐字为** **「**Full integration guide:** [partners.guavasure.com - iOS SDK](https://partners.guavasure.com/integration/docs/integrations/ios-sdk)」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **README 只有 2,767 字节，而它把**文档之所在**指向站外**——**⭐ 即**这个仓库不是文档的权威位置****；**② ⭐⭐ **该链接是**合作方站点上的路径**（**`partners.`** 前缀）**——**⭐ 即**它预设读者是**合作方**而不是公众****；**③ **本词条**未访问该链接**——**⚠️ 故**不转述**其内容，**亦**不主张**它可访问**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **同一个产品有三个平台封装，故本词条只收其一，并写明理由**——**逐字为** **「**Same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and `guavasure_flutter`（pub.dev）**」**；**而本词条**实测该组织（`guavasure`）下**只有两个仓库**（**`guavasure-ios` 与 `guavasure-android`，同日创建于 2026-08-25、同日推送于 2026-09-08、同为 GPL-3.0**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **本词条**只收了 iOS 这一个**，**依据是本站既定纪律「不取同一作者的**近重复**兄弟仓库」**——**⭐ 而这里 iOS 与 Android 是**同一产品按平台拆分**（**⭐ 与第 342 轮 [[policyforge-rating-engine]]／[[ratecraft-reserving-pricing]] 那种「**两个不同产品**」的情形不同**）**；**② ⭐⭐ **第三个封装 `guavasure_flutter` 发布在 pub.dev 而不是 GitHub**（**⭐ 即**本站的检索形态会**漏掉它**，**已记入供后续轮次**）；**③ ⭐⭐ **「同一个桥接协议」被明确写出**——**⭐ 即**三端的行为被声明为一致****；**④ **本词条**不主张**三个封装的行为确实一致**（**⚠️ 未读任何一端代码**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其许可选择值得如实记录，且它落在本轮主题上**——**该 SDK 以 **GPL-3.0** 发布**（**实测 `LICENSE` 文件存在**），**而它的用途是让**合作方把保险流程嵌进自己的 App****⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **一个供第三方嵌入的客户端 SDK 采用**传染性许可**，是「许用范围」与「交付用途」之间一处需要读者自己读条款的组合**——**⚠️ 本词条**不作任何法律结论、**不主张**这构成问题**（**⭐ 本条只如实记录**许可选择与交付用途两件事实**）；**② ⭐⭐ **它与同一组织的 Android SDK 采用同一许可**（**⭐ 即**这是**有意的产品级选择**，**而不是单个仓库的偶然**）；**③ **本词条**未读 `LICENSE` 内容**——**⚠️ 故**不转述**条款**；**⭐ 提示：**有意在自有 App 中嵌入者**应先读 `LICENSE` 或联系该组织，而不是依据本词条**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **其特性清单里有一条是具体的**工程取舍**，而不是功能名**——**逐字为** **「**No embed reload on Safari return**（**embed polls in background**）」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **它说明了一个用户可见行为的**实现方式**（**从 Safari 返回时不重载嵌入内容，因为在后台轮询**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「优化了体验」，而是**说清了怎么做到的**；**② **其余特性也逐条具体**：**`GuavasureBridge` 的 WKWebView 通道／经 `razorpay-pod` 的原生 Razorpay 结账／**支付链接的 `SFSafariViewController` 回退**／文件选择、登出、返回三个回调／**可选的合作方代收支付处理器**／经 `GuavaSureEmbedViewController.warmup(config:)` 的**可选预热****——**⭐ 其中**「回退路径」与「代收支付」两项**都属**边界情形**（**一个是支付失败时怎么走，一个是钱由谁收**）。**⑥ ⭐ **其余可核实事实**：**① **支付走 Razorpay**（**经 `razorpay-pod`**）**——**⭐ 本词条指出：**Razorpay 是印度支付网关**，**故**可推断该产品的市场包含印度**（**⭐ 已标明为推断**）；**② **「合作伙伴鉴权」被列为桥接能力之一**（**partner auth**）**——**⭐ 即**身份来自合作方而不是该 SDK 自身**；**③ **仓库**无 topics、无 homepage 字段****（**⭐ 即**元数据很少**，**而 README 里却有合作方文档链接**）**。**⑦ ⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[kong-insurance-api-bundle]]、[[insurance-data-tools]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[insurance-client-attribution]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[uae-health-pricing-model]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ **许可为 **GPL-3.0****——**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件**，**⭐ 本词条**未读其内容**，**故**不转述**条款、**不主张**任何关于其义务范围的结论**；**⚠️ 本词条特别提示**：**该仓库的用途是让合作方把保险流程嵌入自有 App**，**故**有意使用者应自行读 `LICENSE` 或联系该组织**（**⚠️ 本词条不提供法律意见**）。**② ⚠️⚠️ **本次**未使用该 SDK 的任何一步****——**未克隆、未解析 Swift Package、未构建任何 iOS 工程、未运行任何代码、未在设备或模拟器上嵌入、未访问其合作方文档链接**；**故**本词条**不主张**该 SDK 可用、其桥接协议确实在三个平台一致、或其支付路径（含回退）确实工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 的逐字声明与仓库的**实际文件清单**（**⭐ 而后者正是本条的主要依据**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读任何 Swift 源码的内容****——**⭐ 即**本词条**未核对**：**`Security/Policies.swift` 到底规定什么**；**`ChunkedJsDelivery.swift` 是否确实与分块投递注入脚本有关**（**⚠️ 本词条已把这一点标为**推断**）；**`GuavaSureUrlBuilder` 构造的 URL 指向何处**；**是否存在任何被嵌入流程之外的数据处理**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**「承保与保单逻辑全在远端」这一判断的实现层证据**——**⭐ 本词条的判断依据是**文件清单中不存在相应模块**，**⚠️ 这属于**由缺失推出的结论**，**而**不是一个被读到的实现细节**；**⭐ 本词条据此**不主张**其远端流程的具体内容或归属**（**⚠️ 甚至**不主张**该产品确实在运行**）。**⑤ ⚠️⚠️ **未核实**其托管流程的数据处理、隐私政策或合规状态**——**⚠️ 因其为**客户端 SDK**，**故**真正的数据处理发生在**该 SDK 之外**，**而本词条**未做任何网络观察****；**⭐ 提示：**有意集成者应就该远端流程的隐私与合规单独确认，**而不是只看这个客户端仓库**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实** `guavasure-android` 与 `guavasure_flutter` 的实际内容**（**⭐ 本词条**只核实了该组织下有两个仓库及其元数据**，**未读 Android 端或 Flutter 包**）。**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主张**其产品（宠物险）的条款、定价或可得性**；**本词条**只记录**其客户端 SDK 的形态**。**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其作者、组织的性质或该产品的实际运营状态**——**不主张**它被任何合作方采用或正在运营**。**⑨ ⭐ **★0、fork 0、无 topics**，**关注度为零**，**不主张其成熟度**；**⚠️ 但 ⭐⭐ 本词条指出：**其仓库**仅 45 KB、15 个文件**，**而**这 15 个文件恰好把「一个嵌入式保险客户端」的**可见部分**说清楚了**——**⭐ 即**体积极小、边界极清楚**的一种形态**。**⑩ ⚠️ **创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-08-25／2026-09-08）****。**⑪ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****——**该组织创建不足三周，其仓库会变动**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/guavasure/guavasure-ios` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可 GPL-3.0、★数、fork 数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 topics）；**该组织下全部仓库经 `https://api.github.com/users/guavasure/repos` 实测读取（返回 2 个：ios 与 android）**；README 2,767 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**仓库全部 21 个条目**经下载 `codeload.github.com` tarball 后以 `tar tz` 列出核对（**15 文件、6 目录，已列出全部条目**）；**未克隆、未构建、未运行任何代码、未读任何 Swift 源码或 `LICENSE` 内容、未访问其合作方文档链接、未做任何网络观察、未打开任何图**。

**embedded-pet-insurance-sdk**（倉庫 `guavasure/guavasure-ios`）**是一份內嵌式寵物險的 iOS 客戶端 SDK**（**Swift Package**）：**把託管的保險流程嵌進 `WKWebView`，並實現一套原生橋接**。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **GPL-3.0**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE` 文件**）、主語言 Swift、體量 45 KB、創建 2026-08-25、最後推送 2026-09-08、無 topics、無 homepage 字段**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 2,767 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 21 個條目（15 個文件、6 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「按部分聲明：許可、能力、交付物與使用者各自適用什麼規則」**；**⭐ 它是四條裡**把「交付物按部分分」表現得最明顯的一條——**不是靠文檔說明，而是**文件清單本身**就說明了****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 「你拿到的是什麼」由文件清單本身界定：倉庫裡只有橋接與呈現層**：**其 README 第一句逐字為** **「Swift Package that **embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in `WKWebView`** and implements `GuavasureBridge` for **native Razorpay Checkout, file pick, camera capture, and partner auth**.」**；**而本詞條實測其源碼清單逐項為** **`Sources/GuavaSureSDK/GuavaSureEmbedConfig.swift`（配置）、`GuavaSureEmbedViewController.swift`（承載嵌入流程的視圖控制器）、`GuavaSureUrlBuilder.swift`（URL **embedded-pet-insurance-sdk** (repository `guavasure/guavasure-ios`) **is an iOS client SDK for embedded pet insurance**, distributed as a Swift package, **that embeds a hosted insurance flow in a web view and implements a native bridge**. **Measured ★0, 0 forks, licence **GPL-3.0** (a `LICENSE` file is measurably present), primary language Swift, a 45 KB repository, created 2026-08-25, last pushed 2026-09-08, no topics and no homepage field** (all GitHub API measurements; **creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 2,767 bytes**; **the repository measures 21 entries (15 files, 6 directories)**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **a system should be declared part by part, with each part’s applicable rules stated**; ⭐ **of the four it is the one where the deliverable’s parts are bounded least by documentation and most by the file listing itself**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the repository**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① What you receive is bounded by the file listing: the repository holds only the bridge and presentation layers** — **the most notable point in this entry**: **its README opens verbatim by describing a Swift package that embeds the hosted GuavaSure insurance flow in a web view and implements the bridge for native Razorpay checkout, file picking, camera capture and partner authentication**; **and this entry measured its source listing item by item as**: an embed configuration, an embed view controller, a URL builder, a warm-up type, **three bridge files covering dispatch, injection and script-message handling**, **two internal delivery and encoding helpers**, a payment launcher, **and a security policies file**, alongside a package manifest, licence, readme and gitignore at the root ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **there is no underwriting, pricing, product, policy or claims logic anywhere in the listing, so the whole job of this SDK is to put a remote flow inside a view and relay messages to and from it — this round’s theme at the repository level, since what you receive needs no documentation to establish, the file listing alone shows it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **it uses the word hosted verbatim, so the actual product runs elsewhere**; ⭐⭐ **it has a separate security directory with a policies file, and while that file was not read and nothing is said about its contents, the presence of a dedicated security policy file in an SDK that is otherwise all bridge suggests embedding a third-party flow is treated as having a security surface**; **and one of the two internal helpers concerns chunked delivery of JavaScript, so the injected script may be large enough to need chunking** (⚠️ **an inference from the filename, marked as such**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The integration guide is not in the repository** — the README points its full integration guide at a page on a partner site ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the README is only 2,767 bytes and sends the documentation of record off-site, so this repository is not the authoritative place for the documentation**; ⭐⭐ **the link sits under a partners subdomain, so it presumes a partner reader rather than the public**; **and this entry did not visit that link, so its contents are not restated and no claim is made that it is reachable**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ One product has three platform wrappers, so only one is collected here, with the reason stated** — verbatim, the SDK uses the **same bridge protocol as the Android SDK and a Flutter package published on another registry**; **and this entry measurably found that the organisation holds exactly two repositories, the iOS and Android SDKs, created the same day, pushed the same day and under the same licence** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **only the iOS one is collected, under the site’s standing rule against collecting near-duplicate sibling repositories, since here the iOS and Android repositories are one product split by platform, unlike round 342’s case of two genuinely different products by one author**; ⭐⭐ **the third wrapper lives on another package registry rather than GitHub, so this site’s search shapes would miss it — noted for a later round**; ⭐⭐ **a shared bridge protocol is stated explicitly, so the three platforms are declared consistent in behaviour**; **and no claim is made that they really are consistent, no code having been read on any platform**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its licensing choice deserves recording and lands on this round’s theme** — **it is released under GPL-3.0, and its purpose is for partners to embed the insurance flow in their own apps** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **a copyleft licence on a client SDK intended for third-party embedding is a combination where the permitted scope and the intended delivery use need to be read together by the reader** — ⚠️ **no legal conclusion is drawn and no claim is made that this is a problem; the entry records the licence choice and the delivery purpose as two facts**; ⭐⭐ **the same licence is used on the organisation’s Android SDK, so this is a deliberate product-level choice rather than an accident of one repository**; **and the licence file was not read, so its terms are not restated** — ⭐ **anyone intending to embed it should read the licence or contact the organisation rather than rely on this entry**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ One of its listed features records a specific engineering trade-off rather than a feature name** — verbatim, there is **no embed reload on returning from Safari because the embed polls in the background** ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **it explains how a user-visible behaviour is achieved rather than merely claiming an improved experience**; **and the remaining features are equally specific**: a web-view bridge channel, native checkout through a payment pod, **a Safari view controller fallback for payment links**, file-pick, logout and go-back callbacks, **an optional partner-collected payment handler**, and optional warm-up — ⭐ **with the fallback path and the partner-collected payment both being edge cases, one about what happens when payment fails and one about who collects the money**. **⑥ ⭐ Other checkable facts**: **payment goes through Razorpay** (⭐ **an Indian payment gateway, from which an inference that the product’s market includes India is drawn and marked as an inference**); **partner authentication is listed as one of the bridge’s capabilities, so identity comes from the partner rather than from the SDK**; **and the repository has no topics and no homepage field, so metadata is sparse even though the README carries a partner documentation link**. **⑦ ⭐ Readable with** [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]], [[insurance-data-tools]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[insurance-recommendation-engine]], [[insurance-client-attribution]], [[insurance-distributional-glm]] and [[uae-health-pricing-model]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence is GPL-3.0** — **a `LICENSE` file is measurably present**; ⭐ **its contents were not read, so its terms are not restated and no conclusion is drawn about the scope of its obligations**; ⚠️ **and since the repository exists for partners to embed the insurance flow in their own apps, anyone intending to use it should read the licence or contact the organisation** (⚠️ **no legal advice is offered**). **② ⚠️⚠️ No part of the SDK was used** — **nothing was cloned, the package was not resolved, no iOS project was built, no code was run, nothing was embedded on a device or simulator, and the partner documentation link was not visited**; **so it is not claimed that the SDK works, that its bridge protocol really is consistent across three platforms, or that its payment paths including the fallback really function** — ⭐ **what this entry verified is the README’s verbatim claims and the repository’s actual file listing, the latter being this entry’s primary basis**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No Swift source was read** — ⭐ **so the following were not checked: what the security policies file actually specifies; whether the chunked-delivery helper really concerns delivering an injected script in chunks, an inference already marked as such; where the URL builder points; and whether any data handling exists outside the embedded flow**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ The implementation-level evidence for the judgement that underwriting and policy logic live remotely was not verified** — ⭐ **that judgement rests on the absence of corresponding modules from the file listing**, ⚠️ **which is a conclusion drawn from absence rather than an implementation detail that was read**; ⭐ **so no claim is made about the contents or ownership of the remote flow**, ⚠️ **nor even that the product is running**. **⑤ ⚠️⚠️ The data handling, privacy policy and compliance status of its hosted flow were not verified** — ⚠️ **because this is a client SDK, the actual data processing happens outside it, and no network observation was made**; ⭐ **anyone integrating it should confirm the remote flow’s privacy and compliance separately rather than looking only at this client repository**. **⑥ ⚠️ The actual contents of the Android SDK and the Flutter package were not verified** (⭐ **only that the organisation holds two repositories and their metadata**). **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ No claim is made about the terms, pricing or availability of its pet insurance product**. **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ The nature of the author and organisation and the product’s actual operating status were not verified** — **no claim is made that any partner uses it or that it is in operation**. **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 with 0 forks and no topics**, **attention is zero**, **so no maturity is claimed**; ⚠️ **but ⭐⭐ the repository is only 45 KB across 15 files, and those 15 files happen to make the visible part of an embedded-insurance client perfectly clear — a very small artifact with very clear boundaries**. **⑩ ⚠️ Its creation and push both fall inside the thaw window (2026-08-25 and 2026-09-08)**. **⑪ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11** — **and the organisation is under three weeks old, so its repositories will change**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/guavasure/guavasure-ios` was read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (licence GPL-3.0, stars, forks, language, size, created/pushed dates and topics);
